specification.metadata_model: Axiom metadata inspired by TUF 1.0.28 without wire-compatibility claims
specification.provenance_model: in-toto Statement v1 with SLSA provenance predicate
specification.implementation_claim: No production signing, registry, or verification implementation is claimed.

policy.rollback_protection: reject versions or sequences below exact lock pins and highest-seen state
policy.freeze_protection: reject expired metadata and require monotonic refresh
policy.downgrade_protection: reject versions below the locked or requested version using SemVer precedence
policy.offline_locked: require every pinned root, index, release, signature, target, manifest, and provenance input with no fallback
policy.registry_index_equivalence: registry-index is an Axiom combined release metadata role delegated through timestamp then snapshot; it binds expiry, monotonic generation/sequence, consistent snapshot identity, releases, hashes, and signatures but is not claimed to be wire-compatible TUF metadata

positive_vectors.description: Two unique active rotated publisher keys, two unique index keys, and both old/new root thresholds validate exact offline pins.
The exact authenticated generation, sequence, snapshot identity, and transcript digest may be verified idempotently.
